bead.title: harnesses/codex: emit supported non-empty LimitID
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The Fizeau pre-push test run failed in `internal/harnesses` at `TestHarnessCapabilityMatrixSupportedLimitIDsMatch/codex`: the codex harness capability matrix emitted `LimitID ""`, but the supported set is `[codex codex-weekly]`. This breaks the default test gate and can also make quota/limit accounting ambiguous for Codex routes.

ROOT CAUSE
The codex harness capability metadata path is producing or preserving an empty limit identifier where the supported matrix expects a concrete Codex limit ID. The failure was observed during the 2026-05-21 pre-push run from /home/erik/Projects/fizeau.

PROPOSED FIX
Trace the codex capability matrix construction and ensure every Codex capability entry carries a valid supported `LimitID` such as `codex` or `codex-weekly`, according to the existing supported-limit mapping. Add/adjust a focused regression test so an empty `LimitID` cannot reappear.

NON-SCOPE
Do not rename supported Codex limit IDs, change quota semantics, or special-case the failing assertion away. The fix should align the emitted metadata with the supported matrix.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestHarnessCapabilityMatrixSupportedLimitIDsMatch/codex` passes and asserts no Codex capability emits an empty `LimitID`.
2. A focused regression test covers the codex capability construction path that previously emitted `LimitID ""`.
3. `go test ./internal/harnesses/... -run 'TestHarnessCapabilityMatrixSupportedLimitIDsMatch|Codex' -count=1` passes.
4. `go test ./internal/harnesses/... -count=1` passes.
